title: Insubordinate conduct toward warrant officer, noncommissioned officer, or petty officer.
bodyText:
Any warrant officer or enlisted member who:

(1) Strikes or assaults a warrant officer, noncommissioned officer, or petty officer, while that officer is in the execution of that officer's office;

(2) Wilfully disobeys the lawful order of a warrant officer, noncommissioned officer, or petty officer; or

(3) Treats with contempt or is disrespectful in language or deportment toward a warrant officer, noncommissioned officer, or petty officer, while that officer is in the execution of that officer's office,

shall be punished as directed by a court-martial.
